name: 360 Gaussian Splatting
definition: A method for generating high-quality 3D spatial representations from 360-degree camera images by combining OpenSfM (for sparse point cloud generation) and Gaussian Splatting (for dense Gaussian conversion). It solves the problem that standard Gaussian Splatting assumes perspective cameras and cannot directly process equirectangular images from 360-degree cameras.
summary: 360 Gaussian Splatting generates 3D representations from equirectangular images by replacing Colmap with OpenSfM and modifying rasterization for spherical rendering, eliminating the need to crop 360-degree photos.
